old_description: B.J.Zh.F.Panther Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. ("Panther") was founded in 2002, a subsidiary of ITG Health Technology, which is controlled by Xiamen ITG Group Corp., Ltd. (stock code: 600755), a core enterprise of the Fortune Global 500 conglomerate Xiamen ITG Holding Group, Panther stands as a leading provider of intelligent minimally invasive surgical solutions in China.
about:
Beijing-based Panther Healthcare Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 as a subsidiary of ITG Health Technology, which is controlled by Xiamen ITG Group Corp., Ltd. (stock code: 600755), a core enterprise of the Fortune Global 500 conglomerate Xiamen ITG Holding Group. The company positions itself as a provider of intelligent minimally invasive surgical solutions in China.

Panther manufactures a comprehensive portfolio of minimally invasive surgical products, including endoscopic staplers, smart staplers, open staplers, ultrasonic scalpels, disposable fixation devices for hernia repair, polymer clips, trocars, and the Panther Ultraseal system. The company also distributes sutures, hernia meshes, and blood vessel titanium clips produced by third parties, and provides OEM manufacturing for certain products. Its devices serve gastrointestinal, gynecologic, thoracic, and bariatric surgical specialties, and are exported to more than 80 countries, with the firm claiming the top export sales ranking among Chinese surgical stapler brands for ten consecutive years from 2016 to 2025.

The company serves hospitals, surgeons, and distributors worldwide, with noted markets including the United States, Germany, Brazil, India, and South Korea. In addition to product supply, Panther operates the Panther Surgical Academy, which organizes surgical trainings, master classes, and clinical immersions globally.

Panther emphasizes an integrated product offering that combines its own manufactured staplers and energy devices with complementary third-party accessories, aiming to provide a one-stop solution for minimally invasive procedures. The firm also highlights its OEM capabilities and global training initiatives as differentiators.

name: Panâh Project
old_description: Panah Project is a New York City–based design studio and full-service sample factory founded in 2019 by husband-and-wife team Morteza Saifi and Evgeniya Khromina. With over 25 years of experience across design, product development, production, and creative leadership, including tenure as former Executive Creative Director of Camuto Group. Morteza leads the studio’s creative and technical vision. Evgeniya brings a background in business, marketing, and sales, guiding strategy, operations, and client partnerships. Under one roof, Panah Project provides hands-on design support, fabric and trim sourcing, pattern making, and sample production for both established brands and emerging designers.
about:
Panah Project was founded in 2019 in Brooklyn, New York, by husband-and-wife team Morteza Saifi and Evgeniya Khromina. The studio's roots trace back to Nairobi, Kenya, where the pair launched an ethical manufacturing initiative that trained women in local communities to produce luxury-quality garments for international markets, creating more than 50 full-time jobs over five years.

Operating from a single facility at 254 36th Street, the company functions as a design studio and full-service sample factory. Its in-house team handles pattern making, sample making, fabric and trim sourcing, cut-and-sew production, grading, fitting, and draping. The factory focuses on low-minimum-order production for emerging and sustainable brands, while also developing footwear lines through established manufacturing relationships in Europe, Asia, and South America.

Panah Project serves a range of clients including established apparel brands, emerging designers, startups, film and theater productions, footwear labels, and bespoke clients seeking one-of-a-kind pieces such as red-carpet looks. For film and theater, the studio creates bespoke costumes tailored to actor measurements and production timelines; for footwear, it supports development across all major categories with flexible minimums.

The founders cite their Nairobi experience as the foundation for the studio's values—fair wages, long-term opportunity, and craftsmanship. Morteza Saifi, formerly Executive Creative Director at Camuto Group, leads creative and technical direction, while Evgeniya Khromina guides strategy and operations. The company emphasizes a streamlined, under-one-roof process that maintains quality control from design through to market-ready pieces.

name: Pappas Foods LLC
old_description: At Lassonde Pappas we deliver award-winning quality, service and reliability. Customer Service is our dedication. We consistently work to ensure customer satisfaction through strategic partnerships, continuous communication and the building of strong long-term relationships.
about:
Pappas Foods LLC, operating as Lassonde Pappas, is headquartered in Springdale, Arkansas. The company manufactures a range of shelf-stable beverages and food products for distribution across multiple channels of trade.

Its product portfolio includes organic, natural, and conventional shelf-stable juices, ready-to-drink teas, enhanced waters, isotonics, and cranberry sauces. Production takes place in strategically located, state-of-the-art multi-process facilities capable of multi-serve, single-serve, and multi-pack formats. An in-house R&D team supports collaborative innovation and product development, while dedicated food safety, regulatory affairs, and quality assurance groups monitor compliance with customer specifications and regulatory requirements.

The company serves customers through many classes of trade nationwide, supplying retail, foodservice, and other distribution channels. Its business model emphasizes strategic partnerships and continuous communication to build long-term relationships.

Lassonde Pappas differentiates itself through award-winning quality, a customer-service-first philosophy, and a commitment to employee development. The firm states that its manufacturing expertise and collaborative R&D approach enable it to deliver exceptional value and meet customers' strategic initiatives.

name: Par Hawaii Refining
old_description: We have deep roots in the islands. We started as The Gas Company in 1904, and as a way to provide more energy security for the islands, built a refinery in Campbell Industrial Park in Kapolei. With the support of local government officials and Hawaii’s congressional delegation, Hawaii was able to establish a refinery, which has been in operation in a Foreign-Trade Zone since 1972. Pacific Resources, Inc. (PRI) became the holding company of The Gas Company and the refinery.
about:
Par Hawaii Refining traces its roots to 1904 when The Gas Company was established in Hawaii. Pacific Resources, Inc. (PRI) became the holding company for both the gas utility and the refinery. Today, Par Hawaii is a subsidiary of Par Pacific Holdings (NYSE: PARR), headquartered in Houston, Texas, while its corporate offices remain in Kapolei on Oahu.

The company operates the only petroleum refinery in Hawaii, where 660 employees run 24/7 operations to convert imported crude oil into gasoline, diesel, fuel oil, ship fuel, and aviation fuels including jet fuel. Refined products move through an integrated logistics network of pipelines, tanker trucks, and barges serving all major Hawaiian islands. Par Hawaii also markets fuels through a statewide retail network of Hele, 76, and nomnom-branded stations. The refinery supplies the energy needs of roughly 1.4 million residents and 8 million annual visitors.

Primary customers include electric and gas utilities, major airlines such as Hawaiian Airlines and Alaska Airlines, the U.S. military, and the general public via retail outlets. Par Hawaii has also formed a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corp. and ENEOS Corp. to develop renewable fuels, and is collaborating with Hawaiian Airlines to explore sustainable aviation fuel production by retooling an existing refinery unit.

The company states its mission as "Humbly Serving Communities," emphasizing reliable, safe, and environmentally responsible energy supply for an isolated island state. Leadership cites integrity, creativity, hard work, and respect as core values guiding a transition toward decarbonization, including carbon sequestration and renewable fuel production, to meet Hawaii's ambitious clean-energy goals.

name: Paragon Metal Fabricators
old_description: Beyond our core services, we offer a wide range of additional capabilities to meet your project needs. From precision machining to assembly and finishing, we provide comprehensive solutions to take your project from concept to completion
about:
Paragon Metal Fabricators was established in 1989 in Erlanger, Kentucky, by brothers Joe, Stan, and Mark Muehlenkamp. After years of planning and market research revealed a strong need for quality metal fabrication in the Cincinnati tri-state area, the three founders combined over 100 years of experience in engineering, sales, and fabrication to launch the business. The company remains family-owned and operated, now led by the second generation—brothers Bryan, Matthew, and Jason Muehlenkamp—who continue the original focus on quality and customer satisfaction.

The shop specializes in sheet metal and structural fabrication, offering flat and tube laser cutting, waterjet cutting, forming, rolling, welding, powder coating, and machining (turning, milling, drilling), along with assembly and finishing. Operations run out of a 42,000-square-foot facility in Erlanger and a new 126,000-square-foot plant in Falmouth, Kentucky, equipped with Bystronic and Cincinnati laser systems, waterjet machines, press brakes, and vertical mills. A team of over 30 employees handles materials from light gauge to heavy plate, supporting prototype work through high-volume production runs.

Paragon serves a diverse industrial base including agriculture, air handling, automotive, consumer products, energy, material handling, mining, construction, and packaging equipment. Customers range from OEMs to contractors across the Midwest tri-state region, relying on the shop for custom metal components and fabricated structures.

The company emphasizes its decades of proven performance, capabilities built to handle difficult jobs, and precision results with efficient delivery. Founders started the business to fill a gap for reliable, quality-focused fabrication, and the second generation maintains that standard with in-house powder coating, certified welders, and a no-minimum-order policy for quotes.

Park serves a broad range of sectors, including automotive, military, medical, industrial, consumer, recreational, off‑road, agricultural, emergency‑vehicle, and construction markets. Customers are primarily OEMs and tier‑one suppliers seeking American‑made assemblies.

The company emphasizes its use of what it describes as the industry’s highest level of automation to deliver cost‑competitive, consistent products, and it highlights its “Made in America” positioning as a core differentiator.

name: Parker Medical Associates, LLC
old_description: For almost 40 years, Parker Medical Associates, LLC has been a premier manufacturer of specialty athletic protective guards and other resin impregnated fiberglass-based products located in Charlotte, NC.
about:
Parker Medical Associates, LLC operates from Charlotte, North Carolina, where it was founded in 1987 by Bruce Parker. Parker began manufacturing a patented fiberglass roll splinting system that transformed fracture care worldwide. The company remains privately owned under Parker’s leadership.

Today the firm focuses on specialty athletic protective guards and resin‑impregnated fiberglass products, serving as the official manufacturer of the EvoShield® GEL‑TO‑SHELL™ line for Wilson Sporting Goods. Its Charlotte facility provides full‑service cut‑and‑sew operations including sewing, contract cutting, specialty knitting, and packaging and fulfillment. The company also produces signature cut‑and‑sew product lines for a range of other customers.

Primary markets include sporting goods, medical devices, and textile manufacturing. Wilson Sporting Goods is a named customer for the EvoShield brand, while the company’s membership in the Carolina Textile District and Manufactured in North Carolina reflects its integration into the regional textile supply chain.

Parker Medical emphasizes ethical manufacturing, stating that none of its products contain substances listed under the EU REACH regulation or California Proposition 65. Its mission highlights quality, responsiveness, corporate citizenship, a safe workplace, and long‑term partnerships built on clear implementation plans from design through delivery.

name: Parts Midwest, Inc.
old_description: Since 1972, Parts Midwest has specialized in helping dealerships strengthen profitability by integrating accessories into the vehicle sales process. Our Accessories Integration Specialists work closely with dealerships to build systems where accessories are offered with every vehicle purchase, every time—boosting margins, enhancing customer satisfaction, and maximizing after-sales revenue in a highly competitive market.
about:
Parts Midwest, Inc. was founded in 1972 in Mounds View, Minnesota. The company operates as a 100% employee-owned business and is part of the SCIPI Companies family, bringing shared ownership and international reach to its partnerships.

The firm specializes in accessories program management for automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and their dealership networks. Its services include in-store training, sales call coaching, dealership performance assessments, and dealer engagement reviews, all structured around a proprietary More Accessories Profitability Process (M.A.P.P.). Parts Midwest also functions as a distribution network, managing accessory logistics outside the factory to reduce build complexity for OEMs. The company reports serving over 900 dealerships.

Its primary customers are new vehicle OEMs and their franchised dealerships across the automotive manufacturing sector. A referenced client includes Ford of Canada, where the company supported accessory business development for a decade.

The company states its mission is to simplify complex accessory programs and strengthen every link in the supply chain by aligning strategy with service, enabling OEMs to achieve consistent, measurable success. Its six stated values—do the right thing, families first, ownership, working together, respectful relationships, and fun at work—guide its approach.

name: Pasco Tool & Plastics Inc
old_description: A quality provider of precision production since 1972. Our business is in tooling, machining, and injection molding. Our passion lies within customer service. We work hard to provide high quality service to a varied customer base. We care about providing great and extensive services for our clients. Whether you need automotive, electronic, military, medical or safety products, Pasco Tool and Plastics, Inc. offers professional guidance within a 28,000 square foot facility. That facility offers a modern, temperature controlled environment enabling us to maintain close tolerances on critical applications. With such a wide range of possibilities, each project requires personal attention, which we are willing to provide. Allow us to help you. We welcome your Request for Quote or Information!
about:
Founded in 1972, Pasco Tool & Plastics Inc. has operated from Meadville, Pennsylvania for over five decades. The company provides tooling, machining, and injection molding services from a 28,000-square-foot, temperature-controlled facility designed to hold close tolerances on critical applications.

Its capabilities span tool design and manufacture, precision machining, and plastic injection molding, supported by a full-service quality control and metrology department. Equipment in that department is calibrated to traceable national standards, and the shop runs first-article inspections with pre-production part approval processes (PPAP) for each project. The facility's climate control helps maintain dimensional stability across production runs.

The company serves automotive, electronics, military, medical, and safety-product markets. Customers range from original equipment manufacturers to tiered suppliers requiring close-tolerance components for critical applications. Each project receives personal attention, with professional guidance offered from initial design through final delivery.

Management emphasizes that quality is built into daily routines rather than inspected in at the end. The firm differentiates itself by staying involved throughout the production cycle, offering professional guidance from design approval through final delivery. Teamwork and continuous improvement are cited as core to their quality commitment.

name: Patterson Elite
old_description: In 1993, the sweet taste of US Nationals victory was finally theirs. “That was the biggest win I’ve ever had. There are so many guys that are great racers that through their whole career haven’t had the opportunity to win at Indy. We had been going to that race since 1976 religiously. To finally get over that hump and win it, that’s the big one.”
about:
Patterson Elite operates from Augusta, Kansas, tracing its roots to 1976 when Allan Patterson turned his garage-based engine-building hobby into a full-time business by 1979. The company remains family-run, with Allan’s son Todd Patterson now operations alongside him.

The shop builds custom race engines and provides a full suite of in-house machining services, including block machining, piston machining, crankshaft balancing, cylinder and line honing, and Superflow engine dyno testing. It also upgrades and customizes COPO Camaros for Sportsman and Factory Stock competition, and acts as a dealer for over 100 high-performance product lines. The staff collectively holds over 100 years of expertise, and every engine is custom engineered, dyno tested, and tuned before it leaves the facility.

Patterson Elite serves drag racers across categories from Sportsman and Competition Eliminator to Factory Stock, Pro Stock, and Pro Stock Truck. Its customers include individual racers and teams looking for turnkey engines, precision machining, or race-ready COPO Camaros, as well as buyers of performance parts from the company’s warehouse outlet.

The company says its differentiation comes from its lightweight piston heritage, in-house coating capabilities for piston skirts and domes, and the 2016 merger with Elite Motorsports that brought world-champion Pro Stock technology into its engine programs. Patterson Elite emphasizes that racers want to buy from someone they trust, and it aims to deliver that trust through custom engineering and race-proven services.
